title: Adaptive Vanguard vs Counterfort
intro: Outcome-labelled six-cell exhibition of a counter-counter. The sheet sees remembered home-lane mass, not Counterfort's identity or hidden plan.

cards.trigger: At least three recently remembered enemies occupied Vanguard's home-return sector.
cards.tactic: The centre Hush-Repulsor-Patchbay trio suppresses signatures, breaks the packed body wall, repairs the sweep, and retakes the own Well.
cards.counterplay: Counterfort can stagger below the mass threshold, split its denial bodies, or leave before the sweep arrives.
cards.fallback: At one or fewer recent enemies, the trio resumes centre control and global Core work.
cards.watch: The home sweep appears from t219 through t392.
